# numerics

Numerical methods, scipy and numpy.linalg style, one subfolder per topic with an import path of its own: `numerics/linalg` (dense linear algebra: `solve`, `svd`, `eigh`, `qr`), `numerics/sparse` (`csr`, Krylov solvers), `numerics/special` (`gamma`, `erf`), `numerics/quadrature` (`quad`), `numerics/roots`, `numerics/interpolate`, `numerics/fourier` (`fft`), `numerics/polynomial`, `numerics/approximation`, `numerics/convolution`, `numerics/differentiate`, `numerics/geometry`, `numerics/spatial` (nearest-neighbour search) and `numerics/inverse`.

## numerics/approximation

Approximating functions and sequences: Chebyshev expansions and adaptive chebfun-style approximation, minimax approximation by the Remez algorithm, Pade approximants and continued fractions, convergence acceleration of sequences and series, and floating-point arithmetic itself (ulps, error-free sums and products, conditioning).

- function `chebfun`: Adaptive Chebyshev approximation of a smooth function. `src/lib/numerics/approximation/chebyshev.ts:333` `omai-engine/numerics/approximation`

## numerics/convolution

Convolution and padding: 1-D convolution and correlation (direct, FFT and overlap-add, numpy and scipy.signal style), N-dimensional deep-learning convolutions with their transposes and patch extraction, and the numpy and scipy.ndimage padding modes they share.

- function `convNd`: Deep-learning convolution over any number of spatial axes. `src/lib/numerics/convolution/n-d.ts:194` `omai-engine/numerics/convolution`
- function `convolve`: Discrete 1-D linear convolution, like numpy.convolve. `src/lib/numerics/convolution/one-d.ts:126` `omai-engine/numerics/convolution`

## numerics/differentiate

Numerical differentiation by finite differences: extrapolated derivatives with error estimates, gradients of sampled data, finite-difference Jacobians and Hessians, stencil weights, complex-step derivatives and difference matrices. Exact derivatives come from `autodiff`; these are for references, sampled data and checks.

- function `derivative`: Derivative of a scalar function by Richardson-extrapolated differences. `src/lib/numerics/differentiate/finite-differences.ts:59` `omai-engine/numerics/differentiate`

## numerics/fourier

Fourier transforms, numpy.fft and scipy.fft style: the FFT for every length (real, complex and N-dimensional), frequency helpers, DCTs and DSTs of all four types with the MDCT, non-uniform transforms, and the chirp-z and zoom FFT.

- function `trig.ts` (file): Discrete cosine and sine transforms of types 1 to 4. `src/lib/numerics/fourier/trig.ts:1` `omai-engine/numerics/fourier`

- function `fft`: Discrete Fourier transform along an axis, like numpy.fft. `src/lib/numerics/fourier/fft.ts:130` `omai-engine/numerics/fourier`

## numerics/geometry

Computational geometry: distances and metrics (scipy.spatial.distance), convex hulls, polygons and clipping, Delaunay triangulations and Voronoi diagrams, segment collision primitives, contours and confidence ellipses, and rotations, homographies and point-set alignment.

- function `cdist`: Pairwise distances between two sets of points, scipy metrics. `src/lib/numerics/geometry/distances.ts:279` `omai-engine/numerics/geometry`
- function `delaunay`: Delaunay triangulation of planar points. `src/lib/numerics/geometry/triangulation.ts:184` `omai-engine/numerics/geometry`

## numerics/interpolate

Interpolation, scipy.interpolate style: polynomial interpolation in barycentric form, piecewise polynomials, cubic, B- and smoothing splines, shape-preserving PCHIP and Akima interpolants, gridded interpolation in any dimension, and scattered-data methods (radial basis functions, inverse distance, natural neighbour).

- function `cubicSpline`: Cubic spline with not-a-knot, natural, clamped or periodic ends. `src/lib/numerics/interpolate/splines.ts:127` `omai-engine/numerics/interpolate`
- function `interp1d`: 1-D interpolation: linear, nearest, previous, next or spline. `src/lib/numerics/interpolate/grid.ts:216` `omai-engine/numerics/interpolate`
- function `rbfInterpolator`: Radial-basis interpolation of scattered data. `src/lib/numerics/interpolate/scattered.ts:134` `omai-engine/numerics/interpolate`

## numerics/inverse

Ill-posed inverse problems, where small noise in the data makes the plain solution useless: spectral regularisation (Tikhonov, truncated SVD), regularising iterations (Landweber, CGLS, LSQR) and the rules for choosing the regularisation parameter (L-curve, GCV, discrepancy principle).

- function `tikhonov`: Tikhonov-regularised solution of an ill-posed linear problem. `src/lib/numerics/inverse/tikhonov.ts:102` `omai-engine/numerics/inverse`

## numerics/linalg

Dense linear algebra, numpy.linalg and scipy.linalg style: determinants and norms, factorisations (Cholesky, LU, QR, SVD, symmetric and general eigendecompositions) as differentiable primitives, triangular and structured solves, matrix equations and matrix functions, orthogonalisation and randomised methods, plus the BLAS and LAPACK-style kernels on plain number arrays that iterative algorithms share.

- function `blas.ts` (file): BLAS-style vector kernels on plain arrays: ddot, dnrm2, daxpy, dgemv. `src/lib/numerics/linalg/blas.ts:1` `omai-engine/numerics/linalg`
- function `randomized.ts` (file): Randomised SVD, range finder and random projections. `src/lib/numerics/linalg/randomized.ts:1` `omai-engine/numerics/linalg`

- function `cholesky`: Cholesky factor of a symmetric positive-definite matrix. `src/lib/numerics/linalg/cholesky.ts:100` `omai-engine/numerics/linalg`
- function `eig`: Eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a general real matrix. `src/lib/numerics/linalg/eig.ts:120` `omai-engine/numerics/linalg`
- function `eigh`: Symmetric eigendecomposition with derivatives. `src/lib/numerics/linalg/eigh.ts:140` `omai-engine/numerics/linalg`
- function `expm`: Matrix exponential by Pade scaling and squaring. `src/lib/numerics/linalg/functions.ts:73` `omai-engine/numerics/linalg`
- function `haarOrthogonal`: Haar-distributed random orthogonal matrix or orthonormal frame. `src/lib/numerics/linalg/randomized.ts:165` `omai-engine/numerics/linalg`
- function `inv`: Matrix inverse, batched and differentiable. `src/lib/numerics/linalg/lu.ts:118` `omai-engine/numerics/linalg`
- function `lstsq`: Least-squares solution of A x = b. `src/lib/numerics/linalg/qr.ts:179` `omai-engine/numerics/linalg`
- function `norm`: Vector and matrix norms, like numpy.linalg.norm. `src/lib/numerics/linalg/basics.ts:154` `omai-engine/numerics/linalg`
- function `qr`: Reduced QR factorisation by Householder reflections. `src/lib/numerics/linalg/qr.ts:132` `omai-engine/numerics/linalg`
- function `solve`: Solve a square linear system by LU, like numpy.linalg.solve. `src/lib/numerics/linalg/lu.ts:96` `omai-engine/numerics/linalg`
- function `svd`: Reduced singular value decomposition, differentiable. `src/lib/numerics/linalg/svd.ts:187` `omai-engine/numerics/linalg`

## numerics/polynomial

Polynomials as coefficient arrays, numpy.polynomial style: the power basis (evaluation, fitting, arithmetic, roots), orthogonal families with their Gauss rules, and partial fractions of rational functions. Coefficients are lowest degree first (numpy.polynomial), except in `residue`, `residuez` and `invres`, which follow scipy.signal and take highest degree first.

- function `polyfit`: Least-squares polynomial fit in the power basis. `src/lib/numerics/polynomial/power.ts:119` `omai-engine/numerics/polynomial`

## numerics/quadrature

Numerical integration, scipy.integrate style: adaptive quadrature (Gauss-Kronrod, Simpson, tanh-sinh), Gaussian rules for the classical weights, rules for sampled data (trapezoid, Simpson, Romberg), iterated and cubature methods in several dimensions, and Monte Carlo and quasi-Monte Carlo integration.

- function `nquad`: Iterated adaptive integration over several variables. `src/lib/numerics/quadrature/multidim.ts:44` `omai-engine/numerics/quadrature`
- function `quad`: Adaptive Gauss-Kronrod integration, like scipy.integrate.quad. `src/lib/numerics/quadrature/adaptive.ts:277` `omai-engine/numerics/quadrature`

## numerics/roots

Root finding: scalar methods with brackets or derivatives, solvers for systems of nonlinear equations with Jacobians from autodiff, continuation methods that follow solutions along a parameter, and roots that are differentiable in their parameters through the implicit function theorem.

- function `brentq`: Brent's bracketing root finder for a scalar function. `src/lib/numerics/roots/scalar.ts:58` `omai-engine/numerics/roots`
- function `root`: Solve F(x) = 0 with newton, broyden or other methods. `src/lib/numerics/roots/systems.ts:599` `omai-engine/numerics/roots`

- table `rootFinders`: The scalar root finders as one named slot. `src/lib/numerics/roots/scalar-options.ts:116` `omai-engine/numerics/roots`

## numerics/sparse

Sparse linear algebra, scipy.sparse style: compressed sparse row matrices and linear operators, Krylov solvers with preconditioners (CG, BiCGSTAB, GMRES, MINRES) and differentiable sparse solves, and Lanczos and Arnoldi eigensolvers.

- function `iterative.ts` (file): Krylov solvers: CG, BiCGSTAB, GMRES and MINRES with preconditioners. `src/lib/numerics/sparse/iterative.ts:1` `omai-engine/numerics/sparse`

- function `cg`: Conjugate gradients for symmetric positive-definite systems. `src/lib/numerics/sparse/iterative.ts:179` `omai-engine/numerics/sparse`
- function `eigsh`: Extreme eigenpairs of a symmetric operator by Lanczos. `src/lib/numerics/sparse/eigen.ts:532` `omai-engine/numerics/sparse`

- structure `csr`: Compressed sparse row matrix from a dense matrix or its arrays. `src/lib/numerics/sparse/csr.ts:67` `omai-engine/numerics/sparse`

## numerics/spatial

Nearest-neighbour search: exact brute force and spatial trees (KD, ball, vantage-point), and approximate indexes for large or high-dimensional data, namely graph search (HNSW, NN-descent), locality-sensitive hashing and MinHash, and vector quantisation (product quantisation, IVF).

- function `kNearest`: Exact k nearest neighbours by brute force. `src/lib/numerics/spatial/brute.ts:136` `omai-engine/numerics/spatial`

- structure `kdTree`: KD tree for nearest-neighbour and radius queries. `src/lib/numerics/spatial/trees.ts:398` `omai-engine/numerics/spatial`

## numerics/special

Special functions as differentiable elementwise operations, scipy.special style: gamma and beta, incomplete gamma and beta, the error function, normal and other distribution functions, logistic and log-domain helpers, Bessel functions, elliptic integrals, and zeta and exponential integrals.

- function `betainc`: Regularised incomplete beta function, the CDF of a beta distribution. `src/lib/numerics/special/incomplete.ts:180` `omai-engine/numerics/special`
- function `erf`: Error function family: erf, erfc, erfinv. `src/lib/numerics/special/erf.ts:38` `omai-engine/numerics/special`
- function `gamma`: Gamma function, differentiable; its log, digamma and beta live beside it. `src/lib/numerics/special/gamma.ts:54` `omai-engine/numerics/special`
- function `gammainc`: Regularised lower incomplete gamma function. `src/lib/numerics/special/incomplete.ts:75` `omai-engine/numerics/special`
- function `ndtr`: Standard normal CDF; ndtri is its quantile. `src/lib/numerics/special/normal.ts:58` `omai-engine/numerics/special`
